name: brahmastra
description: Shared, persistent team memory for your agents: recall what was decided, tried and broken; store decisions and root causes as you work. Connects to your Brahmastra install over MCP.

server_url.title: Brahmastra URL
server_url.description: Your install's API address, without /mcp. A deployed install: https://brahmastra.example.com/v1. A backend on this machine: http://localhost:8001.

api_token.title: Personal API token
api_token.description: Create one in the dashboard under Account > API tokens. Stored in your system's secure credential store.

workspace.title: Workspace
workspace.description: Which workspace (graph) this agent reads and writes, usually one per project or team.
